survey.title: Product experience pulse
survey.objective: Measure task outcome and perceived ease for a recent product task so the team can identify experience regressions and diagnostic follow-up needs.
survey.target_audience: People who attempted the target task in the product within the past 7 days.

consent.text: Participation is voluntary. You may skip optional questions or stop at any time.

decisions: Investigate or prioritize the task when completion or ease crosses a prespecified monitoring threshold.
analysis_plan.missing_data_plan: Keep logic-skipped, optional missing, not applicable, and refusal distinct.
analysis_plan.open_text_plan: Code focused open text using a versioned thematic codebook and review a validation sample.

questions.text: What happened the last time you tried to complete this task?
questions.rationale: Establishes the behavioral outcome for the focal episode.
questions.analysis_use: Report completion distribution and use it to interpret ease.

questions.text: How easy or difficult was it to complete as much of the task as you did?
questions.rationale: Measures perceived ease for the same focal episode.
questions.analysis_use: Primary experience metric; report the full distribution and compare by task outcome.

questions.text: What was the main obstacle, if any?
questions.rationale: Provides a structured diagnostic for the primary outcome.
questions.analysis_use: Report shares among respondents who encountered an obstacle and compare with ease.

choices.label: I could not find what I needed
Something did not work as expected
I did not have the information I needed
It took more time than I had

questions.text: What is one change that would have made this task easier?
questions.rationale: Collects focused diagnostic detail without requiring a long response.
questions.analysis_use: Code themes and connect them to outcome and ease; do not treat theme counts as population prevalence without context.

questions.text: May the research team invite you to a separate follow-up study?
questions.rationale: Obtains permission for future contact without collecting contact data in this survey.
questions.analysis_use: Use only with an approved external contact linkage process.

platform_notes.privacy: Keep response linkage separate from product identity unless the notice and sampling system authorize it.
